landing-welcome-text: Welcome to the verifier-app of EHIC attestations. Please start the verification by optionally adding the treatment date. If you are unsure about the treatment date please proceed with the verification.
landing-identity-text: We will start by asking the customer for a valid passport or identity card. The identity will need to match with the PRC, else the reimbursement of the treatment might be refused.
landing-scan-text: Then please scan the QR code on the PRC if there is one, to assure the validity of the document. The verifier app will then do some checks to assure the customer can be reimbursed for treatment.
landing-result-text: Once verified, the result of the verification can be seen, and the evidence can be sent to your HCP administrative account.
treatment-subtitle: Please specify the date when the treatment occurred (defaults to today)
treatment-date-help: Defaults to today. Click to select a different date (up to 30 days in the future)
treatment-notes-placeholder: Any additional information about the treatment...
treatment-next-step2: Scan QR code on PRC card
identity-subtitle: Verify patient identity before proceeding with QR code scanning
identity-instruction-text: Please request the patient to show his identity card. The Identity needs to match the name, firstname, date of birth on the PRC, and date stored in the QR code. Please make a copy for your records.
identity-checklist-name: Name matches PRC and QR code data
identity-checklist-firstname: First name matches PRC and QR code data
identity-checklist-dob: Date of birth matches PRC and QR code data
identity-button-continue: Continue to Scanning the QR Code
identity-next-step1: Scan QR code on PRC card
scan-camera-active: Camera active - point at QR code
scan-camera-not-available: Camera not available. Please use HTTPS or check browser compatibility.
